items.subject: Refuse to start when a required property still holds its own placeholder text, in `sky-booking`, `sky-offer` and `sky-message`, and replace the object store credential defaults in `sky-offer` so the new check catches them.
Add ArchUnit rules for the three guarantees `openspec/specs/architecture/spec.md` credits to tests that do not enforce them, and settle whatever existing code the new rules fail on.

Move the production hostname and the TLS secret name out of the service chart default values into the production overlay, collapse the documented `kubectl apply` paths onto the charts that already cover them, and set the cross origin allow list in the three production overlays.
Rename `adapters.outbound.service` in `sky-notify` to a name that says it is the WebSocket transport, and move `WebSocketService` with it.
Rewrite the receiver validation paragraph in `sky-message/AGENTS.md` so a reader cannot take its description of the removed check as a description of current behaviour.
Rebuild the container image for every service from the current working tree, so nothing later in this sequence runs on a stale layer.
Delete the k3d cluster, create it again from scratch, and install the whole stack onto it following `config/k8s/local_README.md` from the top.
Run the whole Bruno collection against the fresh cluster with `--env k8s` and require every request and every assertion to pass.
Only once the cluster run has passed, stop the k3d cluster and bring the Docker Compose stack up from clean.
Run the whole Bruno collection against the compose stack with `--env local` and require every request and every assertion to pass.
Replace the hardcoded origin list in `sky-notify`'s `WebSocketConfig` with a bound property, so the deployed service stops accepting localhost origins.
Rewrite the scenario in `openspec/specs/helm-charts/spec.md` that expects a no-overlay render to produce placeholder values.
Move the in-cluster record for the identity provider host out of the `NodeHosts` key of the `coredns` ConfigMap and into a `coredns-custom` ConfigMap that k3d does not own.

Wire the springdoc Gradle plugin into `sky-booking`, `sky-offer` and `sky-message` so `docs/api/openapi/` is produced on every build from a forked run that needs no PostgreSQL, no Kafka, no Keycloak and no object store.

Declare `version = "v1"` in the three controllers so the generated paths read `/api/v1/`, restore every error status the hand-written contracts documented and the generated ones dropped, and stop the two anonymous sky-offer endpoints being marked as needing a token.

Amend `openspec/specs/api-versioning/spec.md`, which pins the annotation literal with no reason and claims the published documents were left working unchanged, and `openspec/specs/sky-common/spec.md`, which calls the contracts hand-written.
Move the 401 from `ApiSecuredErrorResponses` into `ApiCommonErrorResponses` in `sky-common`, leaving the 403 behind, so every endpoint in all three services publishes the status it really answers.

Remove the inline 401 block on sky-offer's owner lookup, which springdoc no longer publishes because the class-level shared annotation wins for the same status, and check the other two controllers for the same leftover.
Move the blank and maximum-length rules for `POST /api/v1/search` into the operation description and delete the inline 400 entry that carries them today.
Rebuild all five container images from the current tree.
Delete the k3d cluster, create it again, and install the whole stack following `config/k8s/local_README.md`.
Run the Bruno collection with `--env k8s` and require every request and every assertion to pass.
Stop the cluster, then bring the compose stack up from removed containers and removed volumes.
Run the Bruno collection with `--env local` and require every request and every assertion to pass.

Each generated document carries one `servers` entry naming the port the forked documentation build binds, 7971, 7972 and 7973. Those exist only during a Gradle build, so a client generated from any of the three contracts has a base URL that is nowhere. Restore the three real entries each hand-written document carried, from configuration per service rather than from a literal in shared code.

Replace the service-naming edge prefixes `/offer/api`, `/booking/api` and `/msg/api` with the path the service actually serves, `/api/v1/...`, in the gateway routes, every ingress in every chart and overlay, the Bruno collection and the documents that state the old shape. The rewriting disappears: the edge matches the resource and forwards unchanged.
Stop docker compose publishing 5552, 5553, 5554 and 5555 to the host, so it matches the cluster, where only the ingress on 5777 is reachable.
Once the edge path and the service path are the same string, put the gateway and production entries back in the generated contracts, which could not be expressed while a prefix was being swapped.
Amend the api-versioning and helm-charts specifications for the new public addresses, through the OpenSpec change workflow.
Rebuild all five images, fresh k3d cluster, collection with `--env k8s`, then compose from clean and collection with `--env local`, on the new paths.

Give each service its own base URL variable in the Bruno collection, so a request reads `{{offerUrl}}/api/v1/offers`, and add a `direct.yml` environment pointing them at 5552, 5555 and 5553 with a static token-shaped string instead of a Keycloak call.

The gateway routes four API paths and none of them matches `/swagger-ui` or `/v3/api-docs`, and the service ports are no longer published, so no documentation UI can be opened under compose. The cluster still serves them through their own ingresses at `/offer/swagger-ui` and friends.

The six documentation ingresses set no `x-forwarded-prefix` annotation, so springdoc hands the browser a root-absolute config address the cluster serves at no prefix. Swagger UI then falls back to its demo document.
Bridge widget to live tool list plus verify plus commit
Fix gate to log-only on tool events plus commit
Diff setup vs upstream plus Claude revert plus commit
Implement todo.updated subscription plus mismatch watchdog plus docs, no commit
